DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (ITP).

The clinical picture of frequent epistaxis, gum bleeding, and petechiae in a 4-year-old male is highly suggestive of ITP. I have reached my limit of 10 questions and must proceed with this diagnosis based on the classic presentation of isolated mucocutaneous bleeding in a child.
